description: Use +store then Buy to purchase Oran or Razz Berry. +berry help explains your one personal Oran bed: one bag seed, four real hours, free watering once per stage, yield 1-5 and no decay or automatic replant. +berry status, +berry plant Oran Berry, +berry water, +berry harvest. +berry snack Razz Berry=<party slot, name, full ID or fusion> feeds a PF2 food equivalent for up to 10 HP outside battle. It is independent of growing; it grants no contest, lure or friendship effect. The back exit returns to the hub. Stock is finite with no refill or resale.
